verdict.rationale: Channel3 has a dedicated price-tracking webhooks doc stating that when you subscribe to price tracking for a product, you receive webhook notifications whenever the price changes. That is genuine event subscription via webhooks, but the evidence shows only this single event type, and the evidence pack quotes just one line from that page. Missing for 10: a broader event catalog beyond price changes, documentation of payloads, signing/verification and retries, a webhook management API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
